bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Daily planning and Focus Intention flows are now cleaner and easier to manage
- Session setup, Shield, and focus controls feel more consistent across the app
- Header and progression visuals are clearer, with smoother XP feedback and polish

## Improvements

- Support form now better auto-fills your info (including linked email and saved name)
- Support requests now send clearer contact context so replies are easier
- Large internal cleanup improved stability and maintainability across core features

## Why this matters

Daily Planning & Focus Polish (v4.3.0) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the app feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Daily planning and Focus Intention flows are now cleaner and easier to manage gets a little more room to breathe.
- Session setup, Shield, and focus controls feel more consistent across the app gets a little more room to breathe.
- Header and progression visuals are clearer, with smoother XP feedback and polish gets a little more room to breathe.
- Support form now better auto-fills your info (including linked email and saved name) gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
